definitions: The object of a person's ambition or effort; an aim or desired result.
In football (soccer), hockey, and some other games, a pair of posts linked by a crossbar and often with a net, forming an area into which the ball or puck must be propelled to score.
A point scored in a game such as football (soccer) or hockey when the ball or puck is propelled into the goal.
The finishing point of a race.
examples: Achieving the goal of a fairer society.
The team has scored 36 goals this season.
She was the first to reach the goal.
